title: [BugFix][WeightTransfer] Fix DeepSeek-V4 Flash Vision reload with native retention
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Fixes the one-card DeepSeek-V4 Flash Vision sleep → wake → NPU IPC reload path and adds an end-to-end vision weight-transfer lane. This follows #18630 and #19248 and uses the existing Worker `sleep_preserve_parameter_names` mechanism from #18838. The source branch starts from the official upstream main base recorded at the end of **Regression scope**; the contributor fork only hosts the source branch. The production changes are implemented on that base rather than inheriting the production commits from #19248.

#### The fixes

1. **Reuse native multimodal processing.** Remove the obsolete four-argument `_call_hf_processor` override and its tokenizer thread cache. The pinned vLLM processor handles normalized image inputs and text processing through its existing interface.
2. **Let Worker restore weightless normalization state.** Register the existing `RMSNorm(has_weight=False).weight` tensor as a nonpersistent buffer, preserving its object and attribute name. Native buffer backup/restoration and `Module.to()` can then manage it. Traverse `modules()` because quantization modules can overload `apply()`.
3. **Derive vision markers from current parameters.** Build the sentinel table from the current `image_start`, `image_pad`, `image_newline` and `image_end` values on each forward, with the requested dtype/device, instead of retaining a detached stale table across weight updates.
4. **Fill omitted preserved parameters through native reload.** At update start, record the current parameters selected by the existing retention configuration, once per actual owning module. At finish, consult native layerwise loading records and submit only parameters omitted by the trainer to their original reload loaders. Trainer-supplied new values take precedence. This avoids duplicate accounting through shared module paths and prevents early completion from suppressing later incoming values. Transaction references are cleared in `finally`.

Implementation changes are limited to four production files and six test files. The production diff is +56/-74 lines. The existing Worker, RoPE, HCCL, packed transport and global reload skip sets remain at the historical base; no new production environment variable is introduced. The E2E helper adds checkpoint-compatible vision/aligner/marker parameters and actual image requests so the oracle exercises the vision path.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes: DeepSeek-V4 Flash Vision weight updates can complete across level-2 sleep/wake while preserving explicitly selected parameters omitted by the sender. Sending new values for those parameters still updates them with the retention configuration enabled. There is no new public API or CLI option; callers use the existing `--sleep-preserve-parameter-names` option with served-model names. A release-note fragment records the bug fix.

Weightless normalization tensors become nonpersistent buffers. The sentinel table now performs a small stack/cast on each execution; no performance improvement is claimed.

### How was this patch tested?

One physical Ascend NPU (device 3), TP=1, BF16; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp reduced to **4 text layers, 2 vision layers and 8 experts**, maximum length 1024, memory utilization 0.45, block size 32. Model Runner V2 uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, capture size 1; the no-graph control uses `NONE`. Vision encoder graphs are disabled in both runs.

The transfer payload consists of deterministic fixed-seed checkpoint-compatible test tensors. An independent reference server loads the same tensors normally from safetensors; this checks transfer correctness rather than pretrained-model accuracy. Environment: Python 3.12.13, torch 2.10.0+cpu, torch-npu 2.10.0.post4, Transformers 5.14.1, triton-ascend 3.2.2 and CANN 9.1.0. Both packages are editable installs pointing to their corresponding source trees.

```bash
source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
source /path/to/venv/bin/activate
cd /path/to/vllm-ascend
export VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1
export VLLM_RL_TEST_DEVICE_INDEX=3
export VLLM_RL_DSV4_MODEL=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
export VLLM_RL_DSV4_TEXT_LAYERS=4 VLLM_RL_DSV4_VISION_LAYERS=2
export VLLM_RL_DSV4_EXPERTS=8 VLLM_RL_DSV4_MEM_UTIL=0.45
unset VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER VLLM_RL_DSV4_SKIP_SLEEP VLLM_RL_DSV4_HASH_LAYERS \
  VLLM_RL_DSV4_RESET_MM_CACHE VLLM_RL_DSV4_DUMMY_TEXT_ONLY \
  VLLM_RL_DSV4_CUDAGRAPH_MODE VLLM_RL_DSV4_MM_ENCODER_GRAPH
test_file=tests/e2e/pull_request/one_card/rlhf/state_transitions/test_npu_ipc_weight_transfer_dsv4_flash_vision.py
python -m pytest -sv "$test_file"

VLLM_RL_DSV4_CUDAGRAPH_MODE=NONE VLLM_RL_DSV4_MM_ENCODER_GRAPH=0 \
  python -m pytest -sv -k test_retention_with_vision_reload "$test_file"
```

The related unit run covered:

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  tests/ut/models/test_deepseek_v4_moe.py \
  tests/ut/models/test_deepseek_v4_vision.py \
  tests/ut/models/test_deepseek_v4_vision_preprocess.py \
  tests/ut/models/test_deepseek_v4_weight_loader_reload.py \
  tests/ut/worker/test_sleep_parameter_retention.py \
  tests/ut/worker/test_worker_v1.py \
  tests/ut/distributed/weight_transfer/test_npu_ipc_engine.py \
  tests/ut/distributed/weight_transfer/test_packed_tensor.py
```

#### Result

| Local validation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Full update + retention, FULL_DECODE_ONLY, packed/unpacked | 4 passed, zero errors/skips/failures (878.346 s) |
| Retention, NONE, packed/unpacked | 2 passed, zero errors/skips/failures (521.997 s) |
| Related model, loader, Worker, IPC and packed transport unit tests | 253 passed, zero errors/skips/failures |
| Mypy on the four modified production modules and consolidated vision test, Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 | Passed for all three targets |
| Complete repository format check | `bash format.sh ci`: passed, all hooks |

The hardware runs used production/test commit `97458f9fdc8979b0c9940b775fcb5d8ed13c53d3`; source SHA256 manifests bind the results to those files. Any subsequent release-note-only commit leaves those tested files unchanged. GitHub CI results are separate from these local results.

Four retention evidence JSON files cover **12 selected parameters**: 3 `tid2eid`, 4 `bias_vl`, 1 `e_score_correction_bias` and 4 `attn_sink`. Each checks two distinct current-value states, CPU backup hashes, restored device values and unchanged storage addresses at start/finalize/finish boundaries and after KV-cache wake. Test-only poisoning happens after allocator remapping and before Worker restores CPU copies. Probes resolve native meta placeholders to the retained kernel parameter and account for shared aliases.

The controls verify trainer-supplied new values with preservation still enabled, full updates after disabling preservation and level-1 sleep. Text/image output and token logprobs match independent normal-startup references. Native CPU reload regressions reproduced duplicate shared-module accounting and suppression of supplied new values before the fixes. The standard weights pool released about 26.96 GiB in the full-update reduced-model lane; other retained/update runs vary with their allocation state. This is a lifecycle observation, not a memory benchmark.

#### Regression scope

- The NPU IPC completion change affects models using `sleep_preserve_parameter_names`; the empty-pattern path continues through native initialization/finalization. Other model families were not hardware-tested. Packed/unpacked transport itself is unchanged.
- No new process-global reload skip rules or meta-materialization override is installed. Selected omitted parameters participate in native loader accounting; parameters already supplied by the trainer are not replaced by retained values.
- Normalization tests cover original-object/value preservation, nonpersistent state, repeated registration and dtype conversion. IPC tests cover shared modules, shared parameters, repeated current values, stable addresses and supplied-value precedence. Vision tests verify updated marker values and the native processor interface.
- Git merge compatibility against official main `33746f6e0810c0c2886a6fafde1b9ba9ced47ed7` was checked cleanly. Hardware results apply to the historical base plus the tested implementation, not the synthetic merge tree.
- Full-size checkpoints, pretrained-weight accuracy, FP8, multi-card/HCCL, vision-encoder graphs and broad performance benchmarks were not run. Retention tests require a vLLM revision exposing the existing retention field and explicitly skip on older versions; the recorded runs had zero skips.
- Dependency/deprecation warnings, native `Failed to load weights` fallback warnings for `AscendRMSNorm`, `ComplexExpRotaryEmbedding`, `AscendDeepseekSparseAttention` and `AscendUnquantizedFusedMoEMethod`, and producer-shutdown IPC warnings remain visible in logs. Functional assertions passed; the two hardware logs recorded 476 HTTP responses, all 200. Four evidence files retain the parameter and generation checks.
- **vLLM base used for local validation:** [c4df37dfcc7f72ca41cd43801a468526ecf99a2b](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c4df37dfcc7f72ca41cd43801a468526ecf99a2b), with no local vLLM source changes. CI-selected version metadata is reported separately.
- **vllm-ascend base:** official upstream main commit [19c2f7a7cb1504d4624620ea59d6c7fa9eadc422](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/commit/19c2f7a7cb1504d4624620ea59d6c7fa9eadc422), including #18838. The source branch starts directly from this commit.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: Packed/unpacked, shared module/parameter aliases, hash/non-hash routing, two current-value states, omitted and supplied retained parameters, full update and level-1 controls.
- [x] **Regression test**: Native reload tests reproduce incorrect shared-module accounting and dropped trainer-supplied new values; model tests cover normalization state, marker freshness and processor compatibility.
- [ ] **Error / failure path coverage**: No hardware timeout or transport-failure injection was performed.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: Real CPU backup hashes, NPU values, storage addresses and text/image logprobs against independent startup references.
- [ ] **Performance impact**: No broad benchmark or performance regression measurement; the per-forward marker stack/cast cost and validation limits are documented above.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/a98247ab4db686ee03c66d5feb3c761e52a2f8ab
